us3 played Half-Life DeathMatch, or more specifically Adrenaline Gamer - a mod in Half-Life - when she was introduced to QuakeWorld by a friend in November, 2018. She has since been actively improving in QuakeWorld, mentored by [[Bernkaoch]] and [[DOG_SACRIFICE]], becoming notably skilled in racing, something she also did well in Half-Life.
